issues: Review volume has declined, which the team attributed to staff being too occupied with operational tasks to ask customers for feedback.
Weekday trade is putting pressure on the team and limiting customer engagement.
Water marks and limescale on glassware are affecting the presentation of service items.
The Chinese cooker repair is still outstanding and has been booked late in the evening to avoid disrupting service.

Region-wide (South England): Inconsistent service standards across the region were identified as the single biggest area for improvement, with basics such as checking back on tables, recommending dishes and engaging with customers not being done reliably.

Region-wide (South England): A lack of structured pre-shift planning is leaving teams short of essentials such as ice and napkins, forcing managers to scramble mid service and affecting customer satisfaction.
Region-wide (South England): Managers are carrying out administrative tasks during busy periods instead of supporting the floor, and over-delegating rather than leading their sections.
Region-wide (South England): Team members are working in isolation, with weak communication between front and back of house and staff leaving sections without telling colleagues.
Region-wide (South England): Poor handling of complaints, rather than the original mistakes, was identified as the main driver of negative reviews.
Region-wide (South England): Waste management remains unresolved because follow up with the contact (Kyle) has not been proactive, and issues are being left until they become red light problems.
Region-wide (South England): Stress and anger from management is influencing both the team and customers, and morale needs active attention.
Region-wide (South England): A backlog of facility repairs across sites, including air conditioning and general maintenance, needs external handyman support to clear.
Region-wide (South England): Managers are struggling to locate the correct folders on the system for GM and head chef meeting notes, so information is not reaching teams.

Region-wide (South England): Inconsistent food delivery timing during busy service was raised, with some customers served very quickly while others wait much longer, driving negative reviews (raised by sujan, whose site is not identified in the source).
